defiscan.label: Stage 0
defiscan.verbatim: Stage 0. _Lido V2_ is a liquid-staking protocol. Liquid staking allows users to deposit `ETH` for staking to a set of _Node Operators_ who run validators with `ETH` staked in Lido. In exchange for depositing `ETH` users get `stETH`, _Liquid staked Ether_, a token issued by Lido which represents the staked `ETH`. This token can then be used throughout DeFi in other protocols, for example, as collateral. Lido takes a 10% fee on the yield, split between the _Lido Treasury_ and _Node Operators_. _Lido V2_ uses a system of _Staking Modules_ as explained in the [Protocol Analysis](#protocol-analysis). Each _Staking Module_ has its own set of _Node Operators_, incentive mechanisms, and potential penalties. Currently three modules exist: the _Curated_, _Simple-DVT_, and _Community_ staking modules. Validators in the first two have to be approved by _Lido Governance_, whereas anyone can become a _Node Operator_ for the _Community Staking Module_ by depositing a bond.

keyFindings.title: Aragon Agent (0x3e40D73E) Unverified on Etherscan
keyFindings.description: The Aragon Agent is the on-chain proxy admin for LidoLocator, StakingRouter, WithdrawalQueue, VaultHub, LazyOracle, AccountingOracle proxy, CSModule, Burner, Accounting, and all L1 bridge gateways. Without verified source, privileged execution paths cannot be independently audited, yet this contract can upgrade core protocol logic.

keyFindings.title: AccountingOracle Proxy Unverified
keyFindings.description: AccountingOracle (0x852deD01…) submits consensus reports that drive stETH rebases and withdrawal finalization. Proxy is OssifiableProxy with Agent admin; Etherscan source unavailable for independent audit.

keyFindings.title: Burner Contract Unverified
keyFindings.description: Burner (0xE76c5275…) handles stETH share burning for exited validators and coverage fund flows. Unverified bytecode prevents auditing burn authorization and fund routing logic.

keyFindings.title: Ethereum Beacon Chain Is Foundational Single Point of Failure
keyFindings.description: All staked ETH is deposited via the immutable Ethereum deposit contract and validator rewards/penalties are derived from consensus-layer state. A beacon-chain halt, consensus failure, or prolonged CL data unavailability would freeze rebases, withdrawals, and oracle reporting for the entire pool.

keyFindings.title: LDO Token Contract Unverified
keyFindings.description: LDO governance token (0x5A98FcBE…) is unverified on Etherscan. While not directly custodial, unverified token logic prevents confirming mint/burn/pause controls.

keyFindings.title: Veto Signaling Escrow Unverified
keyFindings.description: Veto Signaling Escrow (0x165813A3…) is part of Dual Governance veto mechanics. Unverified status prevents auditing escrow withdrawal and rage-quit logic.

keyFindings.title: L1 Base Bridge Unverified
keyFindings.description: L1ERC20TokenBridge for Base (0x9de443Ad…) is unverified. Controls wstETH bridging to Base; upgrade path cannot be source-audited.

keyFindings.title: OpStackTokenRatePusher Unverified
keyFindings.description: OpStackTokenRatePusher (0xd54c1c64…) pushes wstETH/stETH exchange rates to L2 bridges. Unverified contract cannot be audited for rate manipulation or unauthorized pushes.

keyFindings.title: Arbitrum Chainlink Rate Feed Unverified
keyFindings.description: Chainlink wstETH/stETH rate feed on Arbitrum (0xB1552C5e…) is unverified. L2 integrations relying on this feed cannot have aggregator logic independently verified.

keyFindings.title: Optimism TokenRateOracle Unverified
keyFindings.description: TokenRateOracle on Optimism (0x294ED1f2…) provides rebasing rate data for bridged stETH. Unverified status blocks audit of rate update authorization.

keyFindings.title: Base L2ERC20TokenBridge Unverified
keyFindings.description: L2ERC20TokenBridge on Base (0xac9D11cD…) handles wstETH deposits/withdrawals on L2. Unverified bytecode prevents auditing mint/burn and admin upgrade paths.

keyFindings.title: Polygon DataBus Unverified
keyFindings.description: DataBus on Polygon (0x37De961D…) is unverified. Cross-chain messaging component cannot be source-audited on this deployment.
